run_maml_omniglot_training: run the MAML few-shot Omniglot classification training loop with configurable n-way k-shot parameters
train_inner_loop_adaptation: train a PyTorch model using higher.innerloop_ctx for differentiable inner-loop gradient steps on support sets
test_maml_few_shot_accuracy: test the MAML model on few-shot Omniglot tasks with inner-loop adaptation and report accuracy
plot_training_accuracy_curves: plot train and test accuracy curves over epochs and save as a PNG file
create_flatten_module: create a PyTorch nn.Module that flattens input tensors to 2D for use in sequential networks
